basic_details.scholarship_name: Yenching Academy of Peking University Master's Fellowship in China Studies
basic_details.major_restrictions: Interdisciplinary China Studies with concentrations in: Economics and Management, History and Archaeology, Philosophy and Religion, Politics and International Relations, Law and Society, or Literature and Culture.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~115 to 125 Yenching Scholars selected annually from over 40 countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Extremely competitive global cohort; typically 1 to 3 outstanding Pakistani scholars selected per annual intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 1 to 2 years (Full residential scholarship for Year 1; thesis writing & living stipend for Year 2 in Beijing)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: CNY 3,500 to 5,000 / month living stipend (~PKR 136,500 to 195,000 / month), plus 100% full tuition waiver, single-room accommodation in Yenching Academy House, round-trip international airfare, and comprehensive medical insurance

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants, PRC citizens, and Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan applicants (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Preference is given to candidates 25 years old or younger on August 31 of enrollment year; maximum age rarely exceeds 28.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Minimum of a recognized Bachelor's degree in any discipline with outstanding academic achievement (typically top 5% class standing or CGPA >= 3.70/4.00) from an accredited university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 to apply; selected scholars average CGPA >= 3.80 / 4.00 or First Class Honours.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Open to all academic backgrounds (humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, law, economics, and business).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate students graduating by August 31 of enrollment year.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: None, though candidates are typically recent university graduates or young professionals.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Demonstrated leadership record, extracurricular engagement, public service, and global outlook are critical evaluation pillars.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 (overall), TOEFL iBT minimum 100, Cambridge C1/C2, or native/medium of instruction (if undergraduate degree was conducted entirely in English).
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Chinese proficiency is NOT required for admission, but Chinese language courses are a mandatory component of the Yenching curriculum.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates from Partner Universities must be nominated by their institution's fellowship office; candidates from non-Partner universities apply via direct Open Application.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold concurrent external funding covering identical costs.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the complete Master of Arts in China Studies degree at Peking University.

admission_application_fee.details: No application fee charged to candidates applying to Yenching Academy.

accommodation.details: Free single-room accommodation provided at Yenching Academy House on the Peking University main campus in Haidian, Beijing.

monthly_stipend.details: Generous monthly living allowance of CNY 3,500 to 5,000 / month (~PKR 136,500 to 195,000 / month) disbursed directly to scholar's bank account.

airfare.details: One round-trip economy class international flight ticket between home country and Beijing provided by the fellowship.

visa_fee.details: Chinese X1 Student Visa application fees paid directly to Chinese Visa Application Service Center in Pakistan.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance for Foreign Students in China 100% covered by Yenching Academy.

food_allowance.details: Peking University student cafeterias provide affordable dining; monthly stipend more than covers all living and meal expenses.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Peking University Library (one of Asia's largest academic libraries), Yenching Academy reading rooms, and research databases.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Fellowship provides dedicated research field study funding, including fully funded academic study trips across China.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: 100% funded China field study trips & thesis grants

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized Beijing public transit smart card (Yikatong) with student discounts.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single China #1 elite C9 institution (Peking University, Beijing).
participating_institutions: Yenching Academy of Peking University (Haidian District, Beijing, China)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #14 globally, #1 in Mainland China; Peking University is China's oldest national university and premier humanities & social sciences powerhouse.
available_majors: Master of Arts in China Studies (Economics & Management)
Master of Arts in China Studies (History & Archaeology)
Master of Arts in China Studies (Philosophy & Religion)
Master of Arts in China Studies (Politics & International Relations)
Master of Arts in China Studies (Law & Society)
Master of Arts in China Studies (Literature & Culture)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years (Year 1 residential in Beijing; Year 2 thesis completion)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with top 5-10% standing (CGPA 3.7+), academic transcripts, two letters of recommendation from professors, statement of purpose, research proposal, CV, and English proficiency certificate (IELTS 7.0+ / TOEFL 100+).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Extremely competitive global fellowship on par with Rhodes, Schwarzman, and Gates Cambridge; requires compelling personal narrative, proven intellectual curiosity, and cross-cultural leadership.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Develop a research proposal that clearly links your primary undergraduate field (e.g. economics, public policy, or computer technology) to contemporary or historical China.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Yenching Academy admissions portal, choose your research concentration, upload personal statement, research proposal, transcripts, and register academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check whether your home university is a Yenching Partner Institution (if yes, seek internal nomination; if no, apply via Open Application).
Step 2: Draft personal statement (maximum 750 words) and China-focused research proposal (maximum 1,500 words).
Step 3: Secure two academic letters of recommendation from professors who know your work intimately.
Step 4: Submit complete online application before the strict early-December deadline.
Step 5: International Admissions Committee conducts preliminary dossier screening.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates invited for a 25-30 minute virtual panel interview in January/February.
Step 7: Final offer notifications sent out in late March / early April.
Step 8: Complete Peking University international student enrollment, obtain JW202/visa, and arrive in Beijing in late August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated global fellowship program: Admission to Peking University and the Yenching Fellowship are awarded together as a single package.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted electronically by referees via confidential links sent from the Yenching portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal statement (maximum 750 words) outlining background, life experiences, leadership journey, and why you wish to join the Yenching Academy community.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Research proposal (maximum 1,500 words excluding bibliography) detailing a proposed China-focused academic inquiry within your chosen research track.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Professional 1 to 2 page CV detailing academic background, leadership roles, publications, honors, and language skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Highly rigorous 25 to 30 minute video interview conducted by a multidisciplinary panel of Peking University professors and international scholars.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, or official proof of English-medium undergraduate instruction accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified transcripts and degree certificates; HEC and MoFA attestations required upon formal matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified English translation for all non-English academic documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Yenching Academy admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificate
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete university transcripts showing course grades, grading scale, and degree conferral.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Certified true copies with HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Reflective narrative addressing intellectual path, leadership, and reasons for joining Yenching Academy.
Original academic research proposal demonstrating critical inquiry and scholarly rigor in China Studies.
Confidential evaluation letters from university professors or academic instructors submitted directly online.
1-2 page comprehensive resume highlighting education, leadership, honors, and activities.
IELTS Academic 7.0+, TOEFL iBT 100+, or official English Medium of Instruction proof.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official test score report or MOI letter.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport identification page valid beyond August 2026.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: December 1 (Strict annual deadline for international applicants)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for autumn entry; application window runs August to early December.

selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 25% (Demonstrated leadership track record, community service, global engagement)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (Originality, methodology, and scholarly strength of China research proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Authenticity, self-reflection, and vision articulated in personal statement)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 5% (Depth of professor evaluation and intellectual character endorsements)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Poise, critical thinking, and intellectual agility during panel interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Yenching Academy Executive Admissions Board, Peking University faculty deans, and distinguished international scholars.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review assessing intellectual capability, leadership potential, cross-cultural empathy, and research feasibility.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 4,500 global applicants from over 100 countries
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate CGPA >= 3.80 / 4.00, combined with prominent leadership and cross-cultural initiatives
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with exceptional academic records, proven leadership, intellectual maturity, and a compelling research vision connecting their background with China.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from premier institutions worldwide (Harvard, Oxford, PKU, Cambridge, Princeton, NUS) and top Pakistani universities (LUMS, NUST, Quaid-i-Azam).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: United States, China, United Kingdom, Pakistan, Germany, India, Singapore, Canada, Australia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Yenching Academy never charges application fees or endorses educational consultants; beware of fraudulent commercial agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying to Yenching Academy is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agency written essays or research proposals are immediately detected and permanently blacklisted.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Chinese X1 Visa fee in Pakistan: ~PKR 18,000.
Personal incidentals before first stipend disbursement: ~CNY 2,000 (~PKR 78,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must major in Chinese or East Asian studies. Reality: Candidates from all fields including STEM, law, and economics are enthusiastically welcomed.
Myth: Prior Chinese language fluency is required. Reality: Chinese proficiency is not required for admission.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial forums suggest second-year students must self-fund; in reality, students maintaining good academic standing receive full Year 2 tuition waiver and stipend.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain good academic standing in coursework (minimum grade B or equivalent) throughout Year 1 and Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time residential attendance in Beijing during Year 1; participation in academic seminars, field trips, and Yenching Global Symposium.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Term-by-term evaluation of coursework credits, China field study completion, and master's thesis milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars are expected to devote full time to their studies; part-time internships require formal prior approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are free to pursue international doctorates, join multilateral organizations, or work globally.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or financial repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Fellowship is revoked if a scholar is expelled for academic dishonesty, plagiarism, code of conduct violations, or criminal acts.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Scholars select one of the six approved China Studies research tracks and must adhere to faculty guidelines.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Degree must be completed within the standard 2-year tenure.
